# Lessons

The rules the trials taught, one file each, with the trials that taught them. Back to [the map](README.md).

- [check-against-every-active-mod](../components/core/knowledge/lessons/check-against-every-active-mod.md) (core): A build's gates see that build alone; check what must stay unique across every mod active beside it. - [crash-box-hides-the-error](../components/core/knowledge/lessons/crash-box-hides-the-error.md) (core): A crash box hides the real error; read the dump before guessing.
